items.source: request - payload for the request message to send
items.translation: request - 要发送的请求消息的有效负载

items.source: targetClass - the target type to convert the payload of the reply to
items.translation: targetClass - 将回复的有效负载转换为目标类型

items.source: the payload of the reply message, possibly null if the message could not be received, for example due to a timeout
items.translation: 回复消息的有效负载，如果无法接收消息（例如由于超时），则可能为 `null`。

items.source: destination - the target destination
items.translation: destination - 目标目的地

items.source: Convert the given request Object to serialized form, possibly using a MessageConverter, send it as a Message with the given headers, to the specified destination, receive the reply and convert its body of the specified target class.
items.translation: 将给定的请求对象转换为序列化形式（可能使用MessageConverter），将其作为带有给定标头的Message发送到指定的目的地，接收回复并将其主体转换为指定的目标类。

items.source: Convert the given request Object to serialized form, possibly using a MessageConverter, wrap it as a message with the given headers, apply the given post-processor and send the resulting Message to the specified destination, receive the reply and convert its body of the given target class.
items.translation: 将给定的请求对象转换为序列化形式，可能使用MessageConverter，将其包装为带有给定标头的消息，应用给定的后置处理器，并将生成的Message发送到指定的目的地，接收回复并将其主体转换为给定的目标类。

items.source: postProcessor - post-process to apply to the request message
items.translation: postProcessor - 用于对请求消息进行后处理的处理器

items.source: requestMessage - the message to send
items.translation: requestMessage - 要发送的消息

items.source: An extension of AbstractMessageReceivingTemplate that adds support for request-reply style operations as defined by MessageRequestReplyOperations.
items.translation: 一个扩展了 `AbstractMessageReceivingTemplate` 的类，它添加了由 `MessageRequestReplyOperations` 定义的请求 - 回复风格操作的支持。

items.source: Convert the given request Object to serialized form, possibly using a MessageConverter, send it as a Message to the given destination, receive the reply and convert its body of the specified target class.
items.translation: 将给定的请求对象转换为序列化形式（可能使用MessageConverter），将其作为Message发送到给定目的地，接收回复并将其主体转换为指定的目标类。

items.source: Convert the given request Object to serialized form, possibly using a MessageConverter, apply the given post-processor and send the resulting Message to the given destination, receive the reply and convert its body of the given target class.
